title: PHASE_RESULT Contract
description: All agents dispatched by the Kimi orchestrator MUST return PHASE_RESULT matching this schema. Size limit: ≤ 500 tokens total.

phase.description: Must match the phase name from pipeline.json

status.description: complete = all deliverables met; failed = blocked/critical error; partial = some deliverables, needs follow-up

summary.description: Single sentence describing what was done. No markdown.

counts.description: Use counts instead of lists to stay within token budget

top_issues.description: Only blockers or critical failures. Empty array if none.

artifact_paths.description: Paths to files or status docs containing full detail. Store detail here, not in summary.

next_phase_hints.description: Only context the immediately next phase strictly needs. File paths preferred over descriptions.
